title: Local vanishing gives the pushed injective-resolution augmentation as a quasi-isomorphism
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], i:X.Opens -> X.Etale a continuous functor whose underlying scheme functor is open restriction [def-sc-zariski-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Use abelian sheaves with the coefficient universe of X, assume sheafification on both sites and HasExt in an arbitrary common Ext universe, and assume abelian sheafPullback i additive. Let F be an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Suppose for q>0 the zero endomorphism of U -> H^q(i(U),F) is locally injective [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-iso-locally-bijective]. Then (1) abelian sheafPullback i preserves finite limits; (2) for every injective resolution I of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], the fixed augmentation single(i_*F) -> i_*I, obtained from the inverse single-complex functor comparison followed by i_*(I.ι), is a quasi-isomorphism. The assertion constructs no replacement complex and makes no choice of a comparison map.

source.place: Tags 072W and 0733(1), direct injective-resolution proof; etale-cohomology.tex Tag 09AX; sites.tex Tags 00X5 and 00X6; extension by zero as in sites-modules.tex Tag 03DJ.

proof.text: Put W=i(top). Applying the forgetful equality to U -> top identifies its underlying map with the open immersion X|U -> X. Thus i factors through the localized etale site over W as the usual Zariski inclusion for the underlying scheme W.left=X. The latter inverse image is exact. Direct image is restriction to W followed by this usual direct image, so its left adjoint is usual inverse image followed by extension by zero along the localized-site projection. Extension by zero is exact, so uniqueness of left adjoints gives finite-limit preservation for the specified abelian sheafPullback i. The existential usual-inclusion lemma alone is not applied to this arbitrary i.

Fix an injective resolution I. The free abelian sheaf on a representable represents object sections by sheafification adjunction, free-abelian adjunction and Yoneda. Apply this to I degreewise and use InjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass to identify the Ext cohomology presheaf naturally with the section-complex cohomology presheaf. This comparison handles the arbitrary Ext universe without assuming sheafification there: the section complex and its homology stay in the coefficient universe. Restriction maps commute with the termwise comparison.

The local-injectivity hypothesis on zero transfers through that natural additive comparison, and says every positive section-complex cohomology class is locally zero. The map of that presheaf to zero is locally injective; local surjectivity is automatic because its target has only the zero section, lifted by zero. Its sheafification is therefore zero by the locally-bijective sheafification criterion. Exact sheafification identifies this sheaf with homology of i_*I, as in 072W. Thus all positive homology of i_*I vanishes.

Continuous direct image is a right adjoint and hence preserves the kernel of I^0 -> I^1. Its degree-zero kernel is i_*F. The specified single-complex comparison is the identity in degree zero, so the augmentation induces this kernel identification there. In positive degrees its source and target homology vanish, so its homology maps are also isomorphisms. This is exactly QuasiIso of the displayed fixed augmentation.

theorem zariski_etale_pushed_resolution
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}}
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi_inclusion : i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor)
    (hi : i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      X.smallEtaleTopology)
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [(sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).Additive]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hvan : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q →
      Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
        (0 : i.op ⋙ Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf F q ⟶
          i.op ⋙ Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf F q)) :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology) ∧
    ∀ (I : InjectiveResolution F),
      QuasiIso
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
          (i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology)
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0).inv.app F ≫
          ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map I.ι)
